data.long_meaning: Derived from Judah in the Hebrew Bible, meaning 'praised'. In the New Testament, Judas Iscariot is the name of the disciple who betrayed Jesus. However, the name Judas has a positive connotation in the Hebrew Bible, as Judah is one of Jacob's twelve sons and the eponymous ancestor of the tribe of Judah. The name Judye carries the meaning “Praised” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Judye usually hope their child will grow to embody praised and live with faith, good character and purpose.
